1 define(stages) → 2 dispatch(stage) → 3 produce(payload) → 4 validate(payload) → 5 accept(stage) → 6 retry(error) → 7
Evidence: 7/41 repositories, 6/36 families; 7 trajectories (4 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Sequential agents, prompt templates, pipelines, and transform nodes.
Negative control: Independent prompts with no intermediate-result dependency do not count.
